about:
Philatron Wire and Cable operates from Santa Fe Springs, California, as a U.S.-based manufacturer of wire and cable products. The company describes itself as a leader in technology, creativity, and innovation, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in the available sources.

The company produces bulk wire and cable, molded electrical cable assemblies, and specializes in extra-large flexible cables and coiled cords. Its stated capabilities span 12 volts to 35,000 volts, 28 AWG to 4,000 MCM, and diameters from 1/16 inch to 3.75 inches. Philatron offers a free design service for custom cable solutions and positions itself as a full-service custom manufacturer.

Philatron serves a broad range of markets, including airport ground support electrical power, automobile and heavy-duty trucking, consumer, electrical distributors, electric vehicle, entertainment, medical, military, mining, OEM, oil and gas, transportation, and utility/power sectors.

The company emphasizes its technology, creativity, and innovation as differentiators, along with a free design service for cable solutions. It highlights its specialization in extra-large flexible and coiled cables as a core focus.
